summary: An Accordion that lets several of its three items stay open at once.
use: Reference or feature lists where users compare multiple sections without the others collapsing.
spec: 3 items: `<AccordionItem value="b1" title="Svelte 5 runes">`, `value="b2" title="Headless primitives"`, `value="b3" title="CSS custom properties"`
Item content is plain text passed as children
The accordion is uncontrolled, nothing is bound
